title: security: RBAC v2 KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Harden RBAC v2 enforcement by ensuring KMS key region residency is validated at policy-evaluation time and adding structured audit logs for KMS key usage and region overrides. No API breaking changes; rollout gated behind feature flag and gradual canary.
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require deterministic data residency guarantees for KMS-protected keys and a full audit trail when RBAC policies permit region pinning. This PR enforces KMS region residency checks in the RBAC v2 policy evaluation path, strengthens audit logging for KMS operations (including region metadata), and adds a safe rollout path (feature-flagged + canary).

What this PR does (summary): 1) Add region_residency constraint to RBAC v2 policy engine and evaluate KMS key region vs resource residency at access time; 2) Emit structured audit events for all KMS decrypt/encrypt requests with policy decision context (policy id, actor, resource, requested region); 3) Add KMS residency enforcement config and a migration mode that audits-only for 1 release window; 4) Backfill integration and e2e tests using the kms-emulator and test fixtures; 5) Update docs and Linear/Jira links and add a rollout playbook for SRE/sales.

Checklist: - [x] Add policy predicate and enforcement hooks in rbac service - [x] Instrument structured audit events for KMS usage - [x] Add feature flag (rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce) with audit-only migration mode - [x] Add unit + integration tests covering allowed/denied flows and region-mismatch logging - [x] Update docs and console messaging for residency constraints - [x] Canary rollout plan described in PR notes

Migration/compatibility: Default behavior initially is audit-only (policy checked, event emitted, but not enforced) unless the tenant enables enforcement via feature flag or a managed policy. This allows customers to detect potential denies before turning on hard enforcement. Config is per-tenant and supports per-environment overrides.

Security considerations: All newly emitted audit events include redaction rules for key material and user secrets. The audit pipeline tags events with residency evaluation results so downstream compliance tooling can alert on violations. We validated that no plaintext key material is logged.

Testing: Unit tests in pkg/rbac/policy/* cover predicate evaluation and decision logging. Integration tests run against a kms-emulator in CI that simulates cross-region keys and verifies audit events are emitted and routed to the audit service. E2E tests exercise a canary tenant with enforcement toggled on.

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to staging with feature flag default=off; 2) Enable audit-only mode for 10 canary tenants for 48h; 3) Evaluate telemetry (denies vs expected), fix edge cases; 4) Gradually enable enforcement for customers with validated policies; 5) Full enforcement for new tenants after 30d.

Related: Linear ENG-2114 (RBAC v2 residency enforcement), ENG-2140 (KMS audit logging), Jira SUP-987 (customer support case), INT-4321 (internal compliance request).
